licence_stored: CC-BY-SA-3.0 (the fetcher prints no version; 3.0 follows Fandom's licensing page and this repo's data/kb/NOTICE.md, which lists the GTA Wiki as CC-BY-SA-3.0)
how_read: scripts/kb/fetch_wiki_live_pages.py --api https://gta.fandom.com/api.php --titles <pages> (page text as rendered by the wiki, link markup removed). Every quoted sentence below was checked, by script, to appear word for word in the page text read at the revision named. Several GTA Wiki pages cover many games; a line states a Grand Theft Auto III fact only where the page says so for GTA III or for the 3D games as a whole (GTA III included) with no exception for GTA III. Gang pages mix games in their infoboxes, so only text that names GTA III, or the Gangs in GTA III page, is used for gang facts.

lines.line: Summary: A small Latin American gang that holds the Hepburn Heights district of Portland and is not well armed.

quoted: The Diablos are a Latin American gang led by El Burro and based in Hepburn Heights, Portland.
They are a fairly small gang, and not very well armed.
Hepburn Heights is now completely under Diablos' control.

lines.line: Weak points: They are poorly armed: in Grand Theft Auto III they use only baseball bats on the street, and guns appear only in missions.

quoted: they are poorly armed and use only baseball bats (guns in missions only).

lines.line: Looks like: Members come in two kinds: a red bandana, light blue jeans and a dark blue jacket, or a blue bandana, a dark blue jacket and olive cargo pants.

quoted: There are two variants of Diablos - one with a red bandana, light blue jeans, and a dark blue jacket, and another one with a blue bandana, a dark blue jacket, and olive cargo pants.

lines.line: Tips: Their gang car is the Diablo Stallion, in every game they appear in. The Uptown Yardies are their arch rivals.

quoted: They drive Diablo Stallions in all of the games they are featured in.
They are arch rivals of the Uptown Yardies.

lines.line: Summary: A Chinese criminal gang that controls the Chinatown and Callahan Point areas of Portland.

quoted: The Triads are a Chinese criminal organization that arrived in the city in 1997, with help from the Sicilian Mafia. They control the Chinatown and the Callahan Point areas of Portland

lines.line: Weak points: The page gives no weak point; members carry baseball bats or pistols.

quoted: They carry baseball bats or pistols.

lines.line: Looks like: Blue boiler suits and black bandannas.

quoted: Triad members wear blue boiler suits and black bandannas.

lines.line: Tips: They are enemies of the Leone Family and have a fierce rivalry with it.

quoted: and are the enemies of the Leone Family.
They have a fierce rivalry with the Triads.

lines.line: Summary: The Italian mafia of Portland, based mostly in Saint Mark's with interests in the Red Light District, Chinatown and Trenton; the wiki calls it the most dangerous gang because of its shotguns.

quoted: the Leone Crime Family is an Italian mafia
They are based in Portland, in particular Saint Mark's, but also have interests in the Red Light District, Chinatown and Trenton.
The most dangerous gang is the Leone Family, since they have powerful shotguns

lines.line: Weak points: The page gives no weak point; what to respect is their powerful shotguns, which can easily blow up a normal car in two shots.

quoted: since they have powerful shotguns, which can easily blow up a normal car in two shots.

lines.line: Looks like: Henchmen wear black suits, some with sunglasses, and their gang car, the Mafia Sentinel, is gray in Grand Theft Auto III.

quoted: In Grand Theft Auto III and Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories, Leone henchmen wear black suits, some with sunglasses.
The official gang car of the Leone family is the Mafia Sentinel, a modified jet black (gray in GTA III) version of the Sentinel

lines.line: Tips: Do not drive within range of their shotguns: they make quick work of vehicles. They have a fierce rivalry with the Triads.

quoted: capable of making quick work of vehicles if the player drives within range of their shotguns.
They have a fierce rivalry with the Triads.

lines.line: Summary: A Colombian drug cartel that took parts of Staunton Island and Shoreside Vale and is heavily involved in the drugs trade.

quoted: The Colombian Cartel or simply the Cartel is a Colombian drug cartel
they quickly gained control of parts of Staunton Island and Shoreside Vale. They are heavily involved in the drugs trade

lines.line: Weak points: The page gives no weak point; it calls the Cartel exceptionally well armed.

quoted: The Colombian Cartel is exceptionally well armed

lines.line: Looks like: In Grand Theft Auto III members wear Hawaiian shirts, combat pants, Akruba-style hats and cowboy boots.

quoted: Cartel members wear Hawaiian shirts, combat pants, Akruba-style hats and cowboy boots in GTA III.

lines.line: Tips: Their gang car in Grand Theft Auto III is the Cartel Cruiser. Their main enemies are the Leone Family and the Yakuza.

quoted: Cartel Cruiser (GTA III & GTA Liberty City Stories)
Their main enemies are the Leone Family and the Yakuza.

lines.line: Summary: A Jamaican gang based on Staunton Island that is found only in Newport and also deals around Liberty Campus.

quoted: The Uptown Yardies or simply the Yardies are an African-Caribbean (mostly Jamaican) criminal organization led by King Courtney, based in Staunton Island.
The Yardies can now be solely found in Newport, but appear to be dealing around the Liberty Campus as well

lines.line: Weak points: The page gives no weak point; members carry baseball bats in Grand Theft Auto III.

quoted: Carried by members of the Diablos, Triads and the Uptown Yardies.

lines.line: Looks like: A black short-sleeved hoodie, tan vest and pants, and brown shoes; both kinds of member look the same.

quoted: In GTA III, Uptown Yardie members wear a black short-sleeved hoodie, tan vest and pants, and brown shoes. Both skins of the Yardies appear visually identical in this game.

lines.line: Tips: Their cars are Yardie Lobo lowriders, which are unique in Grand Theft Auto III for their hydraulic suspension. The Diablos are their rivals.

quoted: The gang drives Yardie Lobo lowriders, which are unique for their use of hydraulic suspension in GTA III.
Their rivals are the Diablos

lines.line: Summary: At a six-star wanted level the Army chases you with soldiers, Barracks OL trucks for pursuit and roadblocks, and Rhino tanks for pursuit.

quoted: After the player gains a six-star wanted level in any game set in the 3D Universe, the Army will begin to chase the player. On the ground, two military vehicles are used against the player: the Barracks OL, which is used for pursuit and roadblocks, and the Rhino tank for pursuit.

lines.line: Weak points: Soldiers are always armed with M16s, but only two spawn near each Barracks OL at a roadblock, so they are less lethal than SWAT or the FBI. A Rhino shrugs off small arms fire; explosives, molotov cocktails and the flamethrower can damage it.

quoted: The soldiers themselves are always armed with M16s.
they are not as lethal as the SWAT or the FBI, as only two spawn near every Barracks OL seen in the corresponding roadblock.

The Rhino is practically invincible to small arms fire and collisions; only explosives and the gun mounted on the Police Maverick can inflict damage. Additionally, flame weapons such as the molotov cocktails and the flamethrower are able to damage the tank.

lines.line: Tips: Soldiers drop grenades when killed in Grand Theft Auto III. Law enforcement tends not to use the Rhino's main cannon.

quoted: Dropped by Military soldiers when killed.
Law enforcement tends not to use the main cannon of the vehicle.

lines.line: Summary: Armor that pads your health against gunfire, explosions and fire; in Grand Theft Auto III its pickup is a shield icon, and in the 3D games it gives nearly as many hit points as your full health.

quoted: The body armor's primary function is to serve as padding for the player health, in effect extending the player's resilience to damage from gunfire, explosions and fire.
When included in GTA III, the pickup assumed the appearance of a shield icon
In all of its appearances, armor now offers nearly the same amount of hit points as the player's full health, doubling the player's resistance to damage.

lines.line: Uses: In the 3D games armor can also pad injuries from falls, collisions with vehicles on foot and even melee attacks.

quoted: In addition, armor can now pad injuries from falls, collisions with vehicles on foot, and even melee attacks

lines.line: Tips: In Grand Theft Auto III Ammu-Nation sells it for $3,000 once the mission Last Requests is done, and entering a Police or SWAT Enforcer truck also gives some. A spot in front of every safehouse spawns one after you collect 50 hidden packages.

quoted: $3,000 (GTA III & GTA Advance)
Last Requests (GTA III)
Ammu-Nation (3D Universe, GTA Chinatown Wars, GTA V, GTA Online)
as well as entering the Police/SWAT Enforcer trucks.
For each 10 Hidden Packages collected, a permanent spawn point for a specific item is created in front of all safehouses.
50 Packages: Body Armor

lines.line: Summary: A pickup that restores your health to the maximum; in Grand Theft Auto III they lie in front of every hospital and around Liberty City, often at rest stops, parks and shopping centers.

quoted: Health pickups scattered around the map can restore the player's health to the maximum level.
In Grand Theft Auto III, health pickups can be found in front of all hospitals and scattered throughout Liberty City, often in recreational areas such as rest stops, parks, and shopping centers.

lines.line: Uses: Health is a numbered counter with a default maximum of 100%, and a prostitute's services also restore it, to a possible total of 125%.

quoted: In Grand Theft Auto III and Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, the hit point system is replaced by a numbered counter, with its default maximum as 100%
Employing the services of a prostitute also replenishes health to a possible total of 125%.

lines.line: Tips: If your health runs out you are wasted: you are taken to the nearest hospital, charged a fee and lose all your weapons, and any mission in progress fails. Saving the game does not restore health in Grand Theft Auto III.

quoted: When the player's health is completely depleted, the protagonist is considered "wasted", and is then transported to the nearest hospital, after which a fee for healthcare will be assessed, and all weapons will be confiscated in the 2D and 3D Universes. Any mission that may have been in progress at the time is considered as failed.
by visiting a save point to save the game (in all 3D Universe titles, save for GTA III and Grand Theft Auto Advance

lines.line: Summary: Pills scattered around Liberty City that temporarily boost your speed while slowing down time.

quoted: Adrenaline pills are items scattered around Liberty City in Grand Theft Auto III
When collected by the player, the adrenaline pills give the player a temporary boost of speed while seemingly slowing down time.

lines.line: Uses: While time is slowed your aiming speed stays normal, which helps in gun battles with the police or gangs, and you can jump further than normal.

quoted: While the game's speed is slowed down, the player's aiming speed is the same as it would normally be, which is handy when engaged in gun battles with the police, gangs or during rampages. The player can also jump further than normal.

lines.line: Tips: Entering a vehicle resets the speed to normal. In Grand Theft Auto III there seems to be a glitch where even the smallest drop, such as walking off a sidewalk, can cause considerable damage.

quoted: Strangely, entering a vehicle resets the speed to normal again.

In Grand Theft Auto III and Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, there seems to be a glitch where making the smallest of drops, such as walking off a sidewalk and onto the road, can cause some considerable damage.

lines.line: Summary: A rotating star-shaped police badge pickup that lowers your wanted level by one star; it is a cost-free alternative to respraying your car.

quoted: the bribe appears as a rotating, star-shaped police badge pickup that will reduce the player's wanted level by one star when picked up
the pickup is intended as an cost-free alternative to respraying the player's vehicle at a spray shop

lines.line: Uses: Higher-level police already chasing you (the Military, SWAT or the FBI, for example) keep pursuing, though no more law enforcement vehicles appear. The exception is the Police Maverick, which gives up at three stars and drops you to two.

quoted: any higher-level police presence (Military, SWAT or FBI for example) in the area prior to obtaining the bribe will continue to pursue the player (assuming a wanted level is still in place), but no more law enforcement vehicles appear. The one exception is the Police Maverick, which will disengage from pursuit of a player with a three-star wanted level upon obtaining a police bribe (reducing their wanted level to two stars).

lines.line: Tips: They are scarce, so you have to memorize where they are: some lie in obvious places, some are well hidden, and some sit at a slight height that needs a jump in a car to reach.

quoted: its scarcity makes the tactic more difficult unless the player memorizes their locations. Police bribe locations vary widely, with some showing up in obvious locations, while others are well hidden from plain view. Some require performing a jump in an automobile to reach, as they are positioned at a slight altitude
